## Ticket Triage Agent

Webhook-driven mock helpdesk classifier for the Agent Operations Portal demo.

Contract:
- Inbound: spec §12.1 (execution_id, callback{url,secret}, config.max_tickets, config.priority_threshold)
- Callback: spec §12.2 (status, metrics, result)
- Result schema: spec §14.5 (items_processed, tickets[].ticket_id|priority|sentiment|category|assigned_team, summary)

Deterministic rule-based classifier (keyword maps for priority, sentiment, category). priority_threshold drives the escalation team split: tickets at or above the threshold are routed to support_l2, others to support_l1. config.simulate_failure=true triggers the demo failure callback.
